meta_description:
1,926 likes, 5 comments - manipurpoliceofficial on October 1, 2026: "*Manipur Police Felicitates Asian Games 2026 Silver Medallists*

A felicitation programme was held today at Police Headquarters, Manipur to honour Ms. Saikhom Mirabai Chanu, Addl. SP Sports, and Ms. Naorem Roshibina Devi, Dy. SP Sports, for their outstanding achievement of winning Silver Medals at the 20th Asian Games 2026, Japan.

The programme was attended by the Director General of Police, Manipur, Shri Mukesh Singh, IPS, along with senior officers of Manipur Police. Hon'ble MLA, Lamlai Assembly Constituency, Shri K. Ibomcha Singh, also graced the occasion and accompanied the athletes to the function.

During the interaction session, the athletes shared their experiences, challenges, and memorable moments from their sporting journeys and participation in the Asian Games.

Addressing the gathering, the DGP congratulated the medal winners on their exceptional achievement and lauded their dedication, perseverance and commitment to excellence. He stated that their success serves as an inspiration to the younger generation and brings immense pride to Manipur Police, the State of Manipur and the Nation. He emphasized the importance of nurturing emerging talents and encouraging young sportspersons to pursue excellence in their chosen disciplines. The DGP also conveyed that Manipur Police is considering policy initiatives to further recognize and encourage outstanding sportspersons within the force, in appreciation of their achievements and contributions to sports.

As a mark of appreciation, cash rewards of ₹1,00,000 (Rupees One Lakh) each were presented to the athletes by the Director General of Police, Manipur, in recognition of their outstanding achievements and significant contribution to Indian sports. The gesture underscored the commitment of Manipur Police to encourage sporting excellence and honour personnel who bring laurels to the State and the Nation.".
